stage_expectations.Intro: First learn the idea with support.
stage_expectations.Review: Use the same skill again with less support, a new representation, or a slightly harder context.
stage_expectations.Mastery: Use the skill independently; choose a representation or method when needed and explain when the task requires it.

pipeline_rules: Intro in Unit N becomes Review in Unit N+1 and Mastery in Unit N+2.
Review in Unit N becomes Mastery in Unit N+1.
Goal ID/title/description stay canonical across stages; stage changes evidence demand.

official_exit_ticket.cross_unit: Unit N Section 1 normally reassesses Unit N-1 Section 5.
official_exit_ticket.u1_1: Opening exception intentionally deferred to Bank/Exit map; do not fake prior-section reassessment.
official_exit_ticket.intro_review: Checked formatively elsewhere; targeted teacher-requested reteach/recovery checks are local formative tools.

mastery_goals.title: Slope and Rate of Change
